items.difficulty_reason: The counted corollary is the author corollary at source lines 2281-2283: if Gamma derives A in the sequent calculus then Gamma entails A. The author proof (2285-2293) unpacks derivability into a derivation from a finite subset Gamma_0, invokes the unit's sequent soundness theorem to conclude that every structure either falsifies a member of Gamma_0 or satisfies A, and reads entailment off directly. The passage from the infinite premise set to its finite witness is the counted move.
